essayTitle: Report on the International Students' Visit
source: SPM 2026 Trial · Kelantan · English Paper 2 · Part 3 Q4 · Report, 200–250 words
paragraphs: This report is about the visit of a group of international students to our school from 3 to 9 August 2026. The visit was organised by the International Relations Club.

A total of 15 international students took part in the programme. They were accompanied by three teachers from their home schools. The students came from Japan, South Korea and Indonesia. Each of them was paired with a local buddy throughout the week.

First and foremost, a cultural night was held in the school hall on the first evening. Our students performed traditional dances such as the zapin, while the visitors showcased their own cultural performances. Furthermore, the visitors took part in a batik painting workshop. Many of them were fascinated by the intricate patterns and proudly brought their artwork home. They also sampled local delicacies at the Central Market.

The programme taught us to appreciate cultural diversity. We discovered that despite our different backgrounds, we share many common values. Moreover, it improved our confidence in communicating in English. Many students who were usually shy found themselves chatting freely with their new friends.
In conclusion, the programme was a resounding success. It is recommended that the school continue such exchange programmes to broaden students' horizons and foster international friendships.
